content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text compares the challenger's seed/loins chain with the defender's chain and calls the collision underdetermined, so it is doing the chain-against-chain assessment K-C governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter; the defender's chain is footed but rests on the woman-route inference.","rule_words":"A link is judged by its support, never by whether any verse, or the chain as a whole, states it word for word; and a verse whose words leave the question open decides nothing by itself.","room":"'by footing, never verse by verse' — (1) a footed chain may still fail if it does not explicitly name Joseph; (2) K-C bars using lack of explicit naming as decisive once the chain is footed, because support not word-for-word controls.","why":"The judge treats a footed chain as deficient because it does not explicitly name Joseph, which is a word-for-word/naming test rather than a chain-against-chain decision by footing."}
